summary: React-authored GPU renderer for video and 3D
use_when: Use when authoring scenes in React/TypeScript for GPU-rendered video.
avoid_when: Avoid for unrestricted commercial redistribution; compare a permissively licensed renderer such as Blender.

assessment.rationale: React/TypeScript-authored GPU creative engine uses Rust and Bevy for video, motion graphics and 3D output. FSL-1.1-ALv2 restricts competing products; third-party notices apply. Need release/version evidence and headless determinism details.

install.macos: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/shinyobjectz/raea at 66eb15448f69ab29a801fe1bde75d3889d34d04e; cmake on PATH (Homebrew cmake 4.5.1); CARGO_TARGET_DIR set to a directory outside the clone; cargo build --release -p raea-cli --no-default-features (rust 1.99.1 from rust-toolchain.toml); bun 1.4.2 (npm install --prefix <dir> bun@1.4.2, not global) then bun install --frozen-lockfile in sdk/raea, sdk/react/js and sdk/react/tw and bun run build in sdk/react/js (bun 1.2.18 cannot read bun.lock v2). Binary at target/release/raea; RAEA_OFFLINE=1, RAEA_EXPORT_CACHE=0. No verified Homebrew route
